requests.narrationText:
The Magicians Believe

He invited his magicians to the palace. The magicians came with sticks in their hands. Some were holding ropes. They put down the sticks and ropes on the ground. They were moving like snakes! Then, Allah spoke to Moses (pbuh), “Throw your stick!” Moses (pbuh) threw down his stick and it turned into a huge snake. His stick quickly ate all the snakes of the magicians. The magicians bowed down to Allah. They shouted, “We believe in the Lord of Moses and Harun!” The king still did not believe in Allah, because he was arrogant. The king did not like those people because they believed in Allah. He continued to harm Moses (pbuh) and his people day and night.
